nodes.name: eval_retrieval.py
nodes.summary: DOC_ONLY retrieval evaluation: runs retrieval pipeline on test questions, computes Hit@K (1,3,5,10), MRR, NDCG, fallback rate, and latency. Gold matcher with keyword fallback. Outputs retrieval_eval.json. Supports --reuse flag for cached corpus.

nodes.name: analyze_threshold.py
nodes.summary: Threshold analysis script: analyzes score distributions for positive/negative retrieval results to find optimal RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD. Plots histograms, computes ROC curves, and recommends threshold balancing false positives vs false negatives.

nodes.name: cleanup_eval.py
nodes.summary: Evaluation cleanup script: removes test data from database (conversations, messages, embeddings) created during evaluation runs. Supports --cleanup flag for seed scripts. Ensures clean state between test runs.

nodes.name: diag_retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Retrieval diagnostic script: deep-dive into retrieval failures. Logs vector scores, BM25 scores, rerank scores, and gold rank per query. Identifies failure patterns (OCR issues, chunking, keyword mismatch). Outputs diagnostic JSON.

nodes.name: ocr_tesseract_compare.py
nodes.summary: OCR comparison script: benchmarks Tesseract settings (psm, oem, dpi, lang) on scanned PDFs. Measures character accuracy, diacritic preservation, and processing time. Used to tune pdf_parser.py OCR settings.

nodes.name: breakdown.py
nodes.summary: Latency breakdown (tests/latency): legacy version of test_v2/latency/breakdown.py. Instruments pipeline stages for latency profiling. Kept for backward compatibility with older test scripts.

nodes.name: load_breakdown.py
nodes.summary: Load latency breakdown (tests/latency): legacy version of test_v2/latency/load_breakdown.py. Concurrent load testing with worker pool. Superseded by test_v2 version.

nodes.name: ttft.py
nodes.summary: TTFT measurement (tests/latency): legacy version of test_v2/latency/ttft.py. Time-to-first-token for streaming responses. Superseded by test_v2 version.

nodes.name: build_internal.py
nodes.summary: Memory internal dataset builder: reads blueprint JSON files (bp1-bp6, bp_fix), generates memory_internal.csv with 360 turns (30 conv × 12) or 600 turns (50 conv × 12). Handles conversation threading, gold rewrites, and document references. Fixes merge bug for incremental blueprint additions.

nodes.name: memory_dataset.csv
nodes.summary: QRECC memory dataset CSV: 1240 turns / 250 sessions from QRECC (general knowledge, non-HR domain). Used for baseline memory rewrite evaluation (rewrite_score 0.863 on prod path). External benchmark for comparison.

nodes.name: drill.py
nodes.summary: Stress drill (tests/stress): legacy version of test_v2/stress/drill.py. Sustained load generator for AI pipeline with QPS control and quota monitoring. Superseded by test_v2 version.
